text: Sleek. Fast. BODY 12, no jump penalty, skate-feet analog.

name: EL-F4-NT Linear Frame
text: Zhirafa construction exo. External only. Work, not a fashion show.

name: Fuma Kotaro Frame (worn)
text: External hire. Two interface plugs. You look like a problem.

name: LF-001 SWAT Frame (worn)
text: External SWAT exo. Climb, swim, scare the block.

name: Vermillion Frame (worn)
text: External speed frame. Skate the street without the surgery.

name: EL-F4-NT Frame (worn)
text: Construction exo. Lift the van. Don't dance.

name: Dayton SH-45 Patroller
text: One-seat gyro. Roof work. Loud.

name: Dayton SH-45 Patroller Law
text: Bulletproof gyro with a gun. NCPD yellow.

name: Dayton TDT 004
text: A Dayton that thinks it's a car and a kite.

name: Tanson Bellhop
text: A gyro that folds into a suitcase. Trendy. Fragile.

name: Zetatech AeroVox
text: Economy aerodyne for the corpo who isn't one yet.

name: Zetatech AeroCop
text: Armored police AV. Do not steal unless you mean it.

name: Zetatech Destination
text: Compact AV. Four seats if you like each other.

name: Zetatech Herakles
text: Troop AV. SP and attitude.

name: AmeriCar EconoCompact
text: Three seats. No frills. It starts.

name: AmeriCar Family Star Van
text: A van that has seen things. Still a van.

name: Diego Motors Chupacabra
text: Nomad muscle. Eats dirt. Spits cops.

name: Diego Motors Range Trike
text: Three wheels, armor, a pack on the back.

name: Harvey 100
text: A bike. Honest. Fast enough.

name: Zonda Parallax
text: Cybercycle. 300 mph if the street is a rumour.

name: Zonda Sliver
text: A thin bike. Looks illegal. Is.

name: Zonda Molly 1K
text: Street bike with a name and a waiting list.

name: TetraCorp America MegaHauler
text: A land train. Armor. Cargo. A rolling fortress.

name: TetraCorp America Badger Corporate Bus
text: A boardroom that drives. Converts. Hides.

name: Yang's Wheels Rickshaw
text: A cycle-rickshaw that thinks it's a taxi. Night City weather included.

name: Tanson JetBoy Hoverboard
text: A foot off the ground. 30 mph. Pride is extra.

name: Makigai Ebi
text: A hatchback so cute people forget it has a trunk for a body.

name: Quadra Thunder-X
text: Muscle. Night City still makes these myths.

name: Paladin 500
text: A cruiser that wants a highway that doesn't exist.

name: Zacatzontli Pickup
text: Nomad truck. Off-road. A bed for the pack.

name: Militech Gorgon Security Van
text: A squad box. Enters firefights. Leaves some of you.

name: Grundy
text: A junker with a soul. Or just rust.

name: Arachnid Grenade
text: Goo. They stick. Then you walk over.

name: Shuriken Tornado Grenade
text: A room full of mono-stars. Don't be in it.

name: GunMart Door Cracker
text: A focused bang for a hinge. Cover dies. So might you if it's Poor.

name: Micro Hydrogen Combustor
text: A tiny sun. Don't pocket it next to Smash.

name: KillChip 100 Micro-Bomb
text: Looks like a memory chip. Explodes like a grenade. Rude.

name: KTech Security Grenade
text: Less-lethal if you believe the label. Still a grenade.

name: OUTLet Explosive
text: Looks like a wall wart. Is a bomb. Hotel work.

name: TR-4 Detonator Fluid
text: Paint it. Leave. It cooks. Demo in a bottle.

name: Arasaka Weeping Reaver Katana
text: A katana that weeps fire, acid, or salt into the cut. Excellent. Mean.

name: Kendachi Mono-Katana
text: Mono edge. Armor as half. The classic.

name: Solo Wolf and Bot Mono-Katana
text: A named Kendachi cousin. Looks like a poster. Cuts like one.

name: Kendachi Mono-Wakizashi
text: Shorter mono. Concealable if you lie well.

name: White Hornet Tanto
text: A tanto that wants a kidney. Fast.

name: Rostovic Kleaver
text: A cleaver that starts fires. Two hands. No friends.

name: Zhirafa Rhinocefist
text: A fist like a piston. Cyberarm cousin. Buildings notice.

name: Faisal's Magna Knuckles
text: A punch that also stuns chrome. EMP in the knuckles.

name: Kendachi Mono-Guard
text: A mono whip. Concealable. Reach. Ugly on a dance floor.

name: Utility Tomahawk
text: Tool and thrown. Nomad gospel.

name: Ranger Combat Boomerang
text: Thrown. Comes back if you have the chrome. Otherwise it's a stick.

name: Kendachi Mono-Star
text: A shuriken that spins itself. Mono. Don't catch it.

name: Big Dreem
text: A street club with a name. Molly sells these. They work.

name: Sanroo Hello Cutie 1TruLuv
text: A cute blade. Kawaii until it isn't.

name: Arasaka Prototype Variable Automatic Rifle
text: Rare. With the right parts it is a railgun. SP 7 and under cry.

name: E-TACK Public Defender
text: No trigger. Lethal or less-lethal. Lawman toy. Street copies exist.

name: Eagletech Survivalist
text: A crossbow glued to an assault rifle. Nomad picnic.

name: GunMart Engage Rocket Launcher
text: Cheap rocket. Poor quality. It might kill you first.

name: GunMart Special
text: A pistol from a vending wall. Jams. Affordable last words.

name: Georgia Arms Matchmaker
text: A jury-rigged shotgun. Cheap. Loud. Sometimes both barrels.

name: Militech Mastiff SMG
text: SMG that thinks it's a shotgun. Two personalities. One trigger.

name: Militech Perseus
text: Very heavy pistol. Kinetic recapture. Fires faster if you keep shooting.

name: Nomad Rocker
text: An air gun that throws rocks. Silent. Humiliating. Effective.

name: Superchrome Glam Rifle
text: Looks like a concert. Shoots like a rifle. Bonus to looking expensive.

name: Superchrome Javelin
text: A stylish spear-gun. Walk in like a poster.

name: Superchrome Sidearm
text: A pretty heavy pistol. The club lets you in.

name: Everest VentureWare SportMaster
text: A hunting rifle that wandered into a war.

name: Everest VentureWare SurvivalMaster
text: The SportMaster's meaner cousin. A toolbox with a barrel.

name: Timeless WW1 Rifle to Pistol Conversion
text: A hundred-year-old idea. Still shoots. History as a crime.

name: GunMart Door Gun
text: If the Door Cracker was a gun. Poor. Loud. A hole.
